title: MintyMC.xyz
body:
✨ MintyMC.xyz – Brand New Anarchy+ Server! ✨

Looking for a fresh start on a lawless map but tired of instant spawn kills? MintyMC.xyz just launched, featuring a protected spawn area with games and facilities to give you a fighting chance before you head into the wild.
This is Anarchy+, meaning you get total freedom to raid and grief in the wilderness, but with basic rules to keep the server functional and fair.

🚀 Server Details

    IP Address: mintymc.xyz
    Version: 1.20+ (Supports latest versions)
    Status: Fresh map, just opened!
    Simple Voicechat﻿
